title: OCBC customers face difficulties accessing online, mobile banking services
text:
OCBC customers face difficulties accessing online, mobile banking services - The Business Times Search
 Subscribe OCBC customers face difficulties accessing online, mobile banking services
 Reports have been lodged on tracking site Downdetector since 12.31 pm

 Published Fri, Oct 23, 2026 · 01:49 PM 阅读简体中文版 (beta) 
 OCBC says its staff are “working urgently” to resolve the issue. PHOTO: BT FILE 
 [SINGAPORE] Some OCBC customers reported difficulties accessing the bank’s mobile banking services on Friday (Oct 23), including logging in.
 The disruption affected some customers’ ability to make payments.
 More than 700 outage reports were lodged on tracking site Downdetector from about 12.31 pm, mostly citing the banking app and login issues.
 Customers are facing issues using OCBC’s mobile banking app. IMAGE: OCBC APP In a comment responding to a customer on Facebook, OCBC said its staff were “working urgently” to resolve the issue.
 In response to queries from The Business Times , the bank said that some customers “faced intermittent slowness” accessing its mobile and Internet banking services earlier on Friday afternoon.
 “These services have been progressively restored. Our ATM and card services are not affected. We assure customers that their monies are safe and no customer data is compromised.”
